correctness.rationale: For each distinct non-singleton external trace a representative defines a bipartite outerplanar incidence graph. Rooted block charges sum to 3(m-1)-2s; every negative block forces a distinct compensating B-rooted child of strictly larger positive charge. Therefore charge zero implies only balanced six-vertex 2-connected blocks rooted at A, each a hexagon with at most one chord, joined at A. All four possible local three-support packets follow. Conversely each packet hypertree is realized by gluing the outerplanar blocks plus singleton pendants and an isolate. A leaf-pair Prüfer bijection proves the labelled t-hypertree count and four packet options per triple. The embedded exact checker supports small cases but is not the infinite proof.
